title: Parallax Episode Shot List
description: Per-episode asset manifest. Lists every visual element the episode needs, with sourcing instructions. Consumed by tools/asset-source/source.py (stock photo/video sourcing for type: photo|video|archival) and tools/recraft/recraft.py (AI-generated illustrations and photoreal scenes for type: ai-generate|ai-gen|svg). Produced by the visual-spec skill from a two-column production script.

episode.description: Episode number once assigned at publish time (e.g., 'EP01'). Optional during draft.

slug.description: Episode slug used during draft phase (e.g., 'silicon-trap').

assets.description: All visual assets for the episode. May include both stock and AI-generated entries; tools filter by type.

Asset.description: A single visual asset. Required fields beyond id/type depend on type — stock entries need search_terms, AI entries need description (enforced by allOf below).

id.description: Kebab-case unique identifier within the episode (e.g., 'beat2-1941-embargo-signing'). Used as filename stem for downloaded/generated assets.

type.description: Asset class. photo/video = stock library (Pexels, Pixabay, Unsplash). archival = historical photo from Wikimedia/LoC/etc. ai-generate (or alias ai-gen) = full AI generation via recraft.py (raster). svg = vector illustration via recraft.py.

priority.description: Production priority. P1 = hero asset, must be high quality; P2 = supporting, matters but flexible; P3 = ambient/background, generic stock acceptable. Used by render-qa to weight verification effort.

treatment.description: Brand treatment LUT to apply post-source/post-generation. standard = warm umber→amber default. conflict = ink→rust (tension/adversarial). editorial = desaturated bone tones (historical/archival).

notes.description: Editorial notes for the sourcer or generator — what this asset needs to convey, framing guidance, fallback strategy.

search_terms.description: STOCK ONLY. Ranked list of search queries for source.py. First term gets searched first; later terms used as fallbacks if early searches return zero or low-quality results.

fallback_terms.description: Optional second-tier search terms when search_terms underperforms. Used by source-feedback skill.

description.description: AI ONLY. Full natural-language description of what to generate. The recraft.py preamble (per register) is automatically prepended; this field carries the scene-specific content.

register.description: AI ONLY. Parallax visual register per VISUAL_LANGUAGE.md. atmospheric = constructivist illustration (Soviet/art-deco propaganda). grounding = photoreal mannequin scene (depersonalized humans in real environments). analytical = code-clean diagrammatic illustration (rare; usually belongs in Remotion). Selects the prompt preamble in recraft.py and auto-picks the right Recraft style. Takes precedence over visual_mode. See PROMPT_PREAMBLES.md.

visual_mode.description: AI ONLY (legacy). Pre-register prompt-mode flag; still honored if register is not set. Prefer 'register' for new shots.

context.description: AI ONLY. Narration context surrounding this asset — helps Recraft understand the editorial intent (e.g., 'Beat 4, narration about how the trap closes around all participants').

style.description: AI ONLY. Explicit Recraft style override (e.g., 'realistic_image', 'vector_illustration', 'flat_2.0'). When omitted, recraft.py picks the right style from the register. See `recraft.py styles` for the full list.

allOf.description: Stock entries (photo, video, archival) require at least one search term.
AI entries (ai-generate, ai-gen, svg) require a description.
